title: Once in a blue moon
caption: A blue moon is the second full moon in one calendar month. It isn't blue.

beats.head: It's the *second* full moon in one calendar month.
A full moon cycle is about *twenty-nine and a half* days.
beats.sub: Most months run a little longer, so sometimes two fit.

beats.head: That happens about every *two to three* years.
The name is about *rarity*, not color.

vis.title: BLUE MOON
items: Second full moon in a month

beats.head: Rare, but it *happens*.
beats.sub: Like meeting someone who laughs at your weird jokes.
